# #3040: Patch (part 3 of 11): every Weapon's Health halved, and the Rush Token Launcher reaches a Locked zone
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

Section 4 of #3000, and the Rush Token Launcher row of section 5. Both are card data and the cards' own scripts, with no engine change.

## Health (Attack stays 0)

| Rarity | Now (base / Radiant) | New | Cards |
|---|---|---|---|
| Rare | 0/4 / 0/8 | **0/2 / 0/4** | Beam v3 `stinkyscape-050`, Repeater v3 `-051`, Cannon v3 `-052`, Flak v3 `-053`, Rush Token Launcher `-140`, Fruit Launcher `-141` |
| Epic | 0/6 / 0/12 | **0/3 / 0/6** | Beam v4 `-054`, Repeater v4 `-055`, Cannon v4 `-056`, Flak v4 `-057`, Jade Launcher `-142`, Book Launcher `-143` |
| Legendary | 0/8 / 0/16 | **0/4 / 0/8** | Beam v5 `-058`, Repeater v5 `-059`, Cannon v5 `-060`, Flak v5 `-061` |

Health lives in the catalog alone. Each script restates it:
- in its line-1 header ("0/4 → 0/8");
- in a test constant or literal: c050 `RADIANT_HEALTH` line 151, c051 120, c052 111, c053 146, c054 150, c055 120, c056 111, c057 158, c058 150, c059 120, c060 112, c061 169, c140 `(0, 8)` 257, c141 262, c142 `(0, 12)` 213, c143 302.

An Equip sums stats into its host, so a host's Health after an Equip drops too. Update the rows: `crates/cards/tests/cross/catalog.rs` lines 5431–5541 (step 10) and 6275–6305, `spec/08-catalog.md` lines 634–645 and 731–734, `docs/radiant-audit.md` lines 752–763 and 849–852, and the Weapons' `BUILD.md` rows. The new faces still meet R275 (Radiant about twice base).

## Rush Token Launcher into a Locked zone

With no lane named, a summon already enters the leftmost open zone, else the leftmost empty Locked one (R688, `zones::first_entry_zone`). What stops the Launcher is its own gate: `can_activate` (c140 line 55) uses `open_zones(…, Row::Units)`, which leaves out Locked zones. Switch it to `first_entry_zone(c.state, c.controller, Row::Units).is_some()` (in the prelude through `zones::*`), so the Activate is offered while the only free unit zone is Locked, and its Rush Token is summoned there and makes its forced attack. Its test `r1862003_with_no_open_unit_zone_it_is_not_activated` (about line 206) becomes the Locked-zone case. Update the note R1862003, and add a test of a full row except one Locked zone. Decide whether its words change. If they do, update its catalog text, `zh`, spec row and audit row. The script's behaviour changes, so keep the old script for replays (reconcile).

## Files
- **Owned:** the 16 scripts `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape/c050_beam_v3.rs` … `c061_flak_v5.rs` and `c140_rush_token_launcher.rs` … `c143_book_launcher.rs`; the note `spec/rulings/R1862003.md`.
- **By entry:** the 16 cards' entries in `catalog.json`, `tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `spec/08-catalog.md`, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `BUILD.md`, `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` and, if the Launcher's words change, `card-text.yaml`.
- **Fix** any test the new Health breaks in a file no other part owns, for example the carriers c081–c086, meditative c101, `tests/cross/balance_2521_a.rs` and `_b.rs`, `activate_listed.rs`'s Weapon cases, `apps/web/src/game/starship.real.test.ts` and `StarshipBoard.test.tsx`. Part 4 owns `activate_listed.rs`, so touch only the Weapon cases there.
- **Leave to the reconcile** (name them): `t_dormant_starship.rs` (part 1's, which reads Flak's stats from its definition) and `crates/ai/tests/ai/unstoppable_lethal.rs` (part 10's).

## Check
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards stinkyscape`
- `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --test cards`
- `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo fmt --check`, and `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/game/starship.real.test.ts src/game/StarshipBoard.test.tsx`

### Working in the fullsend tree
This part of #3000 lands on `bot/issue-3000` beside the other parts, with no pull request of its own. One reconcile run makes the branch green, so this part need not pass every check alone, but it tests its own code.
- Read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` before any card change (CLAUDE.md rule 10). Every number is a named constant or a card `param` (rule 9).
- **Rulings** take this sub-issue's own block: R(N×1000) up, for its number N (`docs/issues-and-patches.md`, Ruling numbers). Each has a test named after it and its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/N.md`. Never run `cargo jackioh spec index`.
- **Shared by entry.** Other parts edit other entries of `crates/cards/catalog.json`, `crates/cards/card-text.yaml` (and the `chinese.json` its export writes), `crates/cards/tests/cross/catalog.rs`, `crates/cards/src/census.rs`, `crates/engine/src/config.rs`, `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json`, `spec/06-keywords.md`, `spec/07-tokens.md`, `spec/08-catalog.md`, `docs/radiant-audit.md`, `docs/stinkyscape-set.md` and `BUILD.md`. Change only the entries, rows and constants named here.
- **Left to the reconcile:**
  - `KEPT_SCRIPTS` in `crates/cards/src/history.rs`: keep the Launcher's old script in its own file as `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` §3 says, and name it in your summary;
  - the pending patch fragment;
  - any test in another part's file that your change breaks: name it in your summary.

Its build lands on `bot/issue-3000`, not `main` (fullsend).
